name: Plate Armor
description: Heavy interlocking plates of metal.

name: Chain Mail
description: Interlocking metal rings.

name: Splint Armor
description: Vertical strips of metal riveted to a backing of leather.

name: Ring Mail
description: Leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it.

name: Scale Mail
description: Overlapping pieces of metal like scales.

name: Breastplate
description: A fitted metal chest piece.

name: Chain Shirt
description: Made of interlocking metal rings, lighter than chain mail.

name: Half Plate
description: Shaped metal plates covering most of the body.

name: Hide Armor
description: Crude armor consisting of thick furs and pelts.

name: Studded Leather
description: Leather reinforced with metal studs.

name: Leather Armor
description: Toughened leather.

name: Padded Armor
description: Quilted layers of cloth and batting; light but imposes Disadvantage on Stealth.

name: Elven Chain
description: Fine magical Chain Shirt granting a +1 bonus to AC; even non-proficient wearers are considered proficient.

name: Dwarven Plate
description: Masterwork magical Plate Armor granting +2 AC and Reaction resistance against forced movement.

name: Dragon Scale Mail
description: Magical Scale Mail made from dragon scales (+1 AC, Advantage vs dragon Frightful Presence/Breath, and damage resistance).

name: Armor +1
description: Magical armor reinforced with arcane wards (+1 bonus to AC).

name: Armor +2
description: Magical armor reinforced with potent wards (+2 bonus to AC).

name: Armor +3
description: Legendary enchanted armor granting an exceptional +3 bonus to AC.

name: Shield
description: A sturdy wooden or metal shield.

name: Shield +1
description: An enchanted shield granting +1 bonus to AC in addition to its normal +2 Shield bonus (+3 total).

name: Shield +2
description: An enchanted shield granting +2 bonus to AC in addition to its normal +2 Shield bonus (+4 total).

name: Shield +3
description: A supreme enchanted shield granting +3 bonus to AC in addition to its normal +2 Shield bonus (+5 total).

name: Sentinel Shield
description: While holding this shield, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

name: Spellguard Shield
description: While holding this shield, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects, and spell attacks have Disadvantage against you.

name: Cloak of Protection
description: A shimmering cloak that protects the wearer (+1 AC and +1 to all Saving Throws).

name: Ring of Protection
description: A magical ring granting a +1 bonus to AC and all Saving Throws.

name: Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone)
description: A polished agate granting a +1 bonus to all Ability Checks (including Skills and Initiative) and Saving Throws while attuned.

name: Luckstone
description: Stone of Good Luck: grants a +1 bonus to all Ability Checks and Saving Throws while attuned.

name: Bracers of Defense
description: While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you are wearing no armor and using no shield.

name: Robe of the Archmagi
description: Sets unarmored base AC to 15 + DEX mod, grants +2 to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack bonus, and Advantage on saves against spells.

name: Robe of Stars
description: Grants +1 to all Saving Throws, 6 stars for 5th-level Magic Missile, and Astral Plane entry.

name: Scarab of Protection
description: Grants +1 to all Saving Throws and Advantage on saves against spells.

name: Ioun Stone of Protection
description: An orbiting dusty rose prism granting a +1 bonus to AC.

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
description: Iron gauntlets that grant the strength of an ogre (STR becomes 19 if lower).

name: Amulet of Health
description: An amulet that grants unnatural health (CON becomes 19 if lower).

name: Headband of Intellect
description: Your Intelligence score becomes 19 while wearing this headband (no effect if INT is already 19 or higher).

name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
description: A belt that grants the strength of a hill giant (STR becomes 21 if lower).

name: Belt of Stone Giant Strength
description: Your Strength score becomes 23 while wearing this belt.

name: Belt of Frost Giant Strength
description: Your Strength score becomes 23 while wearing this belt.

name: Belt of Fire Giant Strength
description: Your Strength score becomes 25 while wearing this belt.

name: Belt of Cloud Giant Strength
description: Your Strength score becomes 27 while wearing this belt.

name: Belt of Storm Giant Strength
description: Your Strength score becomes 29 while wearing this belt.

name: Belt of Dwarvenkind
description: Grants +2 Constitution (max 20), Advantage vs poison & Resistance to Poison damage, Darkvision 60 ft, and Dwarvish.

name: Ioun Stone of Strength
description: A pale blue rhomboid granting +2 Strength (max 20).

name: Ioun Stone of Agility
description: A deep red sphere granting +2 Dexterity (max 20).

name: Ioun Stone of Fortitude
description: A pink rhomboid granting +2 Constitution (max 20).

name: Ioun Stone of Intellect
description: A marbled scarlet and blue sphere granting +2 Intelligence (max 20).

name: Ioun Stone of Insight
description: An incandescent blue sphere granting +2 Wisdom (max 20).

name: Ioun Stone of Leadership
description: A pink and green sphere granting +2 Charisma (max 20).

name: Manual of Gainful Exercise
description: Increases Strength score and maximum by 2.

name: Manual of Quickness of Action
description: Increases Dexterity score and maximum by 2.

name: Manual of Bodily Health
description: Increases Constitution score and maximum by 2.

name: Tome of Clear Thought
description: Increases Intelligence score and maximum by 2.

name: Tome of Understanding
description: Increases Wisdom score and maximum by 2.

name: Tome of Leadership and Influence
description: Increases Charisma score and maximum by 2.

name: Staff of Power
description: Grants +2 bonus to AC, Saving Throws, and Spell Attack rolls while held (20 charges of arcane spells).

name: Staff of the Magi
description: Grants +2 bonus to Spell Attack rolls, Advantage on saves against spells, and 50 charges of archmage magic.

name: Wand of the War Mage +1
description: Grants a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and ignores Half Cover on spell attacks.

name: Wand of the War Mage +2
description: Grants a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and ignores Half Cover on spell attacks.

name: Wand of the War Mage +3
description: Grants a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and ignores Half Cover on spell attacks.

name: Rod of the Pact Keeper +1
description: Grants a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC of your Warlock spells, plus 1/Long Rest Pact Slot recovery.

name: Rod of the Pact Keeper +2
description: Grants a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC of your Warlock spells, plus 1/Long Rest Pact Slot recovery.

name: Rod of the Pact Keeper +3
description: Grants a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC of your Warlock spells, plus 1/Long Rest Pact Slot recovery.

name: Amulet of the Devout +1
description: Grants +1 to Spell Attack rolls and Spell Save DC, and allows one extra Channel Divinity use per Long Rest.

name: Amulet of the Devout +2
description: Grants +2 to Spell Attack rolls and Spell Save DC, and allows one extra Channel Divinity use per Long Rest.

name: Amulet of the Devout +3
description: Grants +3 to Spell Attack rolls and Spell Save DC, and allows one extra Channel Divinity use per Long Rest.

name: Arcane Grimoire +1
description: Wizard spellbook focus granting +1 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC and enhancing Arcane Recovery by +1 slot level.

name: Arcane Grimoire +2
description: Wizard spellbook focus granting +2 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC and enhancing Arcane Recovery by +1 slot level.

name: Arcane Grimoire +3
description: Wizard spellbook focus granting +3 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC and enhancing Arcane Recovery by +1 slot level.

name: Bloodwell Vial +1
description: Sorcerer focus granting +1 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC, and recovering 5 Sorcery Points when rolling Hit Dice once per dawn.

name: Bloodwell Vial +2
description: Sorcerer focus granting +2 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC, and recovering 5 Sorcery Points when rolling Hit Dice once per dawn.

name: Bloodwell Vial +3
description: Sorcerer focus granting +3 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC, and recovering 5 Sorcery Points when rolling Hit Dice once per dawn.

name: Moon Sickle +1
description: Silvered Druid/Ranger sickle focus (+1 spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC, +1d4 to healing spells).

name: Moon Sickle +2
description: Silvered Druid/Ranger sickle focus (+2 spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC, +1d4 to healing spells).

name: Moon Sickle +3
description: Silvered Druid/Ranger sickle focus (+3 spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC, +1d4 to healing spells).

name: Rhythm-Maker's Drum +1
description: Bardic focus granting +1 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC, plus 1/dawn Bardic Inspiration recovery.

name: Rhythm-Maker's Drum +2
description: Bardic focus granting +2 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC, plus 1/dawn Bardic Inspiration recovery.

name: Rhythm-Maker's Drum +3
description: Bardic focus granting +3 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC, plus 1/dawn Bardic Inspiration recovery.

name: All-Purpose Tool +1
description: Artificer multi-tool focus granting +1 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC and any cantrip for 8 hours.

name: All-Purpose Tool +2
description: Artificer multi-tool focus granting +2 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC and any cantrip for 8 hours.

name: All-Purpose Tool +3
description: Artificer multi-tool focus granting +3 to spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC and any cantrip for 8 hours.

name: Bracers of Archery
description: Grants proficiency with Longbows and Shortbows and adds a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with ranged attacks using those weapons.

name: Boots of Speed
description: Click heels as a Bonus Action to double walking speed and impose Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you (10 min/Long Rest).

name: Boots of Striding and Springing
description: Walking speed becomes 30 ft minimum (unreduced by Heavy Armor or encumbrance), and jump distance triples.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
description: Your steps make no sound and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to move silently.

name: Winged Boots
description: Grants a Fly Speed equal to your walking speed for up to 4 hours.

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
description: Wisdom (Perception) checks to see you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.

name: Cloak of Displacement
description: Projects an illusion imposing Disadvantage on attack rolls against you until you take damage.

name: Cloak of the Bat
description: Grants Advantage on Stealth checks, flight in Dim Light or Darkness, and 1/dawn Polymorph into a bat.

name: Goggles of Night
description: Grants Darkvision 60 feet (or extends existing Darkvision by 60 feet).

name: Eyes of the Eagle
description: Grants Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
description: Reaction reduces ranged weapon damage by 1d10 + DEX modifier and catches missiles reduced to 0 damage.

name: Gloves of Thievery
description: Grants a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks and Thieves' Tools checks to pick locks.

name: Periapt of Wound Closure
description: Automatically stabilizes you when dying and doubles HP regained from Hit Dice.

name: Periapt of Proof against Poison
description: Grants Immunity to the Poisoned condition and Poison damage.

name: Ring of Free Action
description: Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement, and magic can neither reduce your speed nor paralyze/restrain you.

name: Ring of Evasion
description: Has 3 charges; spend 1 charge as a Reaction to turn a failed DEX save into a success.

name: Ring of Spell Storing
description: Stores up to 5 levels worth of cast spells that the wearer can cast using the original caster's slot/DC.

name: Ring of Invisibility
description: Become Invisible at will as an Action until the ring is removed or you end the effect.

name: Pearl of Power
description: Once per dawn, regain one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower.

name: Necklace of Fireballs
description: Carries detachable beads that detonate as 3rd-level (or higher) Fireball spells (8d6 fire, DC 15 DEX).

name: Mind Sharpener
description: Infused robes/armor with 4 charges: use Reaction when failing a Concentration save to succeed instead.

name: Spell-Refueling Ring
description: Action recovers one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower once per dawn.

name: Alchemy Jug
description: Magical ceramic jug that produces daily quantities of mundane liquids (acid, poison, wine, water, oil, etc.).

name: Weapon of Warning
description: Grants Advantage on Initiative rolls and prevents you and nearby companions from being Surprised.

name: Potion of Healing
description: Regain 2d4 + 2 Hit Points when consumed.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
description: Regain 4d4 + 4 Hit Points when consumed.

name: Potion of Superior Healing
description: Regain 8d4 + 8 Hit Points when consumed.

name: Potion of Supreme Healing
description: Regain 10d4 + 20 Hit Points when consumed.

name: Potion of Invisibility
description: Become Invisible for 1 hour (ends if you attack or cast a spell).

name: Potion of Flying
description: Gain a Fly Speed equal to your walking speed and hover for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Speed
description: Gain the effects of the Haste spell for 1 minute (no Concentration required).

name: Potion of Heroism
description: Gain 10 Temporary Hit Points and the effect of the Bless spell for 1 hour.

name: Antitoxin
description: Grants Advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour.

name: Spell Scroll (Cantrip)
description: A single-use scroll containing a Cantrip (Save DC 13, +5 attack bonus).

name: Spell Scroll (1st Level)
description: A single-use scroll containing a Level 1 spell (Save DC 13, +5 attack bonus).

name: Spell Scroll (2nd Level)
description: A single-use scroll containing a Level 2 spell (Save DC 13, +5 attack bonus).

name: Spell Scroll (3rd Level)
description: A single-use scroll containing a Level 3 spell (Save DC 15, +7 attack bonus).

name: Spell Scroll (4th Level)
description: A single-use scroll containing a Level 4 spell (Save DC 15, +7 attack bonus).

name: Spell Scroll (5th Level)
description: A single-use scroll containing a Level 5 spell (Save DC 17, +9 attack bonus).

name: Bag of Holding
description: Extradimensional bag holding up to 500 pounds / 64 cubic feet while always weighing 15 pounds.

name: Handy Haversack
description: Heward's Handy Haversack: three extradimensional compartments holding up to 120 pounds while always weighing 5 pounds.

name: Portable Hole
description: Fine cloth unfolding into an extradimensional 6-foot-diameter, 10-foot-deep cylindrical space.

name: Thieves' Tools
description: Small file, lock picks, mirror, narrow-bladed scissors, and pliers for disarming traps and opening locks.

name: Healer's Kit
description: 10 uses: stabilize a creature at 0 Hit Points without a Medicine check (or heal 1d6+4+maxHD with Healer feat).

name: Component Pouch
description: Watertight leather belt pouch containing compartments for all free Material spellcasting components.

name: Arcane Focus
description: Crystal, orb, rod, staff, or wand crafted to channel arcane spells.

name: Druidic Focus
description: Sprig of mistletoe, totem, yew wand, or wooden staff for primal Druid and Ranger spells.

name: Holy Symbol
description: Amulet, emblem, or reliquary representing a deity or pantheon for Cleric and Paladin spells.

name: Explorer's Pack
description: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days of rations, waterskin, and 50 ft hempen rope.

name: Dungeoneer's Pack
description: Backpack, crowbar, hammer, 10 pitons, 10 torches, tinderbox, 10 days of rations, waterskin, and 50 ft hempen rope.
